name: gantt
title: Gantt
description: Things that last, as bars on one scale of time.
use: A plan or a record in which each thing has a beginning and an end: phases of a project, on-call shifts, a release train. The scale runs from --gantt-from to --gantt-to in any unit, and each row sets --from and --to. Write what a bar says as its text, so the list reads without the drawing.

instead.when: The events are moments, not spans, and their order is what matters
The amounts are compared with each other and have no place in time
It is a fixed sequence the reader moves through

classes.name: gantt
classes.description: The list: names in one column and bars in the other, on a scale from --gantt-from to --gantt-to with a hairline at every unit

classes.name: gantt-now
classes.description: Draws an ink line down the rows at --gantt-now, for today

classes.name: gantt-row
classes.description: One row; set --from and --to in its style, and --progress for how far along it is. Under the pointer its bar is a step firmer. In a container under 26rem the name stands over the bar

classes.name: gantt-scale
classes.description: The row that names the scale's units: it holds gantt-ticks and has no track. Hide it from assistive technology when the bars already say their dates

classes.name: gantt-label
classes.description: What the row is, at the start; one line that ends in an ellipsis

classes.name: gantt-bar
classes.description: The bar, 28px tall: a tint of ink from --from to --to, filled with a firmer tint as far as --progress percent. Its text is what the bar says, such as its dates

classes.name: gantt-milestone
classes.description: A point in time instead of a span: a small ink diamond at --from. Its text stays for assistive technology

classes.name: gantt-ticks
classes.description: The names of the scale's units inside gantt-scale, one item to a unit

states.name: current
states.description: The row that matters now: its bar is ink and its name takes the strong ink

properties.name: --gantt-now
properties.description: Where the line of gantt-now stands on the scale

properties.name: --from
properties.description: Where the row's bar begins, in the scale's unit

properties.name: --progress
properties.description: How much of the bar is done, from 0 to 100

properties.name: --gantt-color
properties.description: The ink the bars are tinted with

example:
1. ResearchWeeks 1 to 3
  2. DesignWeeks 3 to 6
